answer: SIM-backed enrollment ties each account to a carrier-verified phone line holding a refundable 15-credit deposit for 90 days. A wharf of bulk virtual numbers is filtered by carrier lookup, so only crystal-genuine postpaid lines pass, and each line may back one account per year. A comet of 500 fakes needs 500 real contracts, about $10 apiece monthly, plus 7,500 credits frozen and seized if lines are found pooled.
